title: Rational design of an N,S-dual-doped metal-free catalyst from PPy for efficient electrochemical oxygen reduction
content:
Sustainable Energy Fuels, 2025, 9,1029-1037
DOI: 10.1039/D4SE01528B, Paper
Sanjit Kumar Parida, Hrudananda Jena
This work highlights a simplified approach that exploits the nitrogen rich, free-standing porous network of PPy hydrogel to design an N,S-dual doped porous carbon (N,S-PC) catalyst for efficient ORR by a facile, scalable, one-step pyrolysis route.
